name: pg_agent_gate
abstract: Agents propose, PostgreSQL decides: a native gate between LLM agents and the database
description: With pg_agent_gate an LLM agent proposes one SQL statement instead of running it; PostgreSQL checks it against its own parser, catalog and privileges, shows the exact before/after of every affected row, runs it under the agent's own rights, and records every proposal and refusal append-only. Session-level hooks make the gate the only way in.

pg_agent_gate.abstract: Agents propose, PostgreSQL verifies, runs and records -- and an agent session cannot do anything else
